tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang chog ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ 'dir lam 'bras bur grags pa'i man ngag gi rtsa ba/ lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa la/ las dang po pas phyi dkyil dang sbrags te sgom dgos pa las/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang yang rung ba'i dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la mchod cing bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ra gau ri akar+ṣa ya dza/ oṃ badz+ra tsau ri pra be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta li ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa/ gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re ga'i rtsig pa/ sna rin po che'i pha gu /so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar aṃ las nga rgyal dang ser sna dang*/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ha las phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/

bcom ldan 'das 'phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor bar bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba'i hūṃ las zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kī sngon mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ las 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i haṃ las/ gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi gar stabs can/ spyan gsum pa/ yab lnga po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum lnga g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs kyi yab la 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor rnams g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan 'phyar thabs dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa thugs kar gtod pa'o/ / gzhan yang mig tu sa snying dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rna bar phyag rdor sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ snar mkha' snying ser po nor bu 'dzin pa/ lcer spyan ras gzigs dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral bar sgrib sel ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ snying khar kun bzang dkar po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gzugs gau ri/ rna bar sgra tsau ri/ snar dri bai ta li/ lcer ro ghasma ri/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying gar chos khams mkha' spyod ma/ de rnams sku mdog nag po 'dab ma'i lha dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas par gshin rje mthar byed sngon po thod pa 'dzin pa/ lag pa g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngo bsangs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngo skya ral gri 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yon par stobs po che dud nag rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor lor bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ de thams cad g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de dag thams cad sku'i dbyibs rnam par bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal stong*/ ngo bo zunga'ajug /gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/

snying po ye shes rlung*/ ngo bo nyid kyis skur gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo'i ri dwags/ nas/ g.yung mo sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod sogs/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūṃ/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa/ 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub rdo rje/ sogs/ lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa= bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros tshur 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog= yid la bdag med= spyi bor sku= mgrin par gsung = thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/

thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs dang*/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / zhes sogs brjod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyi rdo rje glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis rjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis ni mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang bas mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / cod pan nas/ brtul zhugs kyi bar la rgyas par ni chu dbang dang 'dra la/ cung zad bsdu na/ oṃ swa bhā wa= bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ aṃ las rin po che ser po aṃ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ gnyis ka rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i= yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo g.yas gri gug dang = gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i= rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / nas/ rin chen dbang bskur chen por sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal ser sna dag /tshor pa'i phung po= mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes= oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ dzṛṃ las pad+ma dmar po dzṛṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ gnyis ka 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon des yu ba/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug= thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i= 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la= sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ / rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa= 'od dpag med kyi= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ nas/ shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang thob 'dod chags dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi go= oṃ swa bhā wa= bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khaṃ las ral gri sngo bsangs sam ljang khu khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ gnyis ka don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i= yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas gri gug= thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i= don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis= oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ye staṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa= don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs/ de ltar na dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag / 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i= oṃ swa bhā wa= rang nyid mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros= bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba= yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo g.yas gri gug=

thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i= rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis= oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal chen che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bha wā= chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ sogs nas/ de ltar na ming gi dbang= gti mug= gzugs kyi phung po= chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes= rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes lta bar gyis/ /oṃ swa bhā wa= paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur la las/ bdag nyid rdo rjai sems pa sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ / sogs dang*/ brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= hi hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig /lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs= dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du 'bul ba= brlab tu gsol/ ces brjod/ de nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang*/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*/ /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ / lan gsum/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ / nas/ brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga= hi hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ thog mtha' med pa'i= dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi sogs/ rgyal bas bzhed/ a srid pa ngo bo= sogs/ dam pa byed par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe a/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma= nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/

rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ / sogs/ slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ / sogs nas/ yid kyi lus ni bstan phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum= nas/ rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ oṃ su pra= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shabha āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes brjod de bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ / de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ / nas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges/ / de nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba/ nas/ bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong bcings/ de nas bla ma he ru ka yab yum thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i byang chub sems kyi thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ / sogs/ dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ thig le mgrin par thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdong bsal/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag / lam tsaṇ+ḍa li sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i= zhes brjod/ gsang dbang ngo*/ / de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab

nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur sogs/ gong ltar/ bstod pa gsol btab gsang dbang ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis gdong bcings/ bla mas/ dga' ster/ sogs/ rtag tu gyis/ zhes rig ma sbyin/ rig mas bshang gci dag ni/ sogs/ spro gyur tam/ dris pa'i lan du/ bshang gci dag ni/ sogs/ spro gyur to/ / rig mas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma= sogs mchog gi dngos grub med/ bhan+dza mo k+ṣa ho/ / zhes pang du byon/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs nas/ āḥs mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs nas/ hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs nas lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog gi dga' bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong g.yogs bsal te/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag/lam pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ / de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ /maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes gdong g.yogs bcings/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra= sogs/ khyod rang yang ni de yis pha/ / zhes mnyam par bzhag go / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdong g.yogs bsal lo/ / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / dbang bzhi pa'o/ / gtso bos ji ltar= sogs lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul ba las/ bka' drin gtang rag gi / zhes 'don pa spos/ deng nas brtsam ste= sogs lan gsum/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/

dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau ri dang puk+ka si la mi bskyod pa/ tsau ri dang sha ba ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai ta li dang tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍom+bhi ni la 'od dpag med/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan pa'am/ so so'i rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ dbang 'bring du len na/ dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol ba btab pa yan chad rgyas pa bzhin byas la/ rdo rje che dang*/ sogs/ slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes pas bla ma 'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi= sogs/ sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag /ji ltar 'das pa'i/ sogs/ rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi= zhes sogs gong ltar ro/ / dga' ster= sogs/ rtag tu gyis/ zhes phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ sogs/ gong ltar ro/ / ye shes 'di ni= sogs/ de yi pha zhes sogs/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ zhes gong ltar ro/ / dbang bsdus pa len par 'dod na/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod pa dang gsol btab snga ma dang 'dra bar byas la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa= nas ṣiñtsa tu maṃ gyi bar dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi= nas/ ṣiñtsa hūṃ gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ zhes gsungs zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi nas/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin 'god/ /mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo phyag rgya chen po/

spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ / snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma= sogs/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /lte ba nas brgyud lus thams cad gang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chag dang bcas pa dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum dang gau ri zhes sogs gong bzhin bsams te/ 'dir de tsam zhig go /zhes pa lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub bar len pa'i rim pa 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgrigs pa ste/ dpal rtag brtan du'o// // zhus so// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 134 -- PAGE 135 -- PAGE 122 -
